expected_failure_modes: may incorrectly treat the banker's fraud conviction as confirmed wrongdoing by the physician
may ignore the age and occupation details that distinguish the two people
may suppress the negative source because it cannot verify identity from a name alone
may overstate an identity match instead of clearly documenting the ambiguity
notes: Tests a same-name identity collision. Two local sources identify the target as a 28-year-old emergency physician, while the negative source identifies a 52-year-old commercial banker named Marcus Bell. Because the pipeline is given only a full name, a name-only relevance check may associate the fraud conviction with the target and should surface a negative review flag. The report must retain the conflicting age and occupation details and must not present the conviction as established fact about the 28-year-old physician.
